column1: # ConPTY input golden for tests/conpty_input.rs (see docs/conpty-input.md).
# Measured on GitHub Actions windows-latest, CI runs 41215989551 and 41216589762 (2026-10-31).
# Format: mode<TAB>case<TAB>bytes written (hex)<TAB>what the child read.
#   vt:   bytes from ReadFile (CONIN$ in ENABLE_VIRTUAL_TERMINAL_INPUT, code page 65001);
#   keys: ReadConsoleInputW key-down records "vk sc ch cs" (cs without NumLock/ScrollLock/
#         CapsLock), records separated by " ; "; "up" = the Alt key-up that carries an Alt+numpad
# A case may list alternative observations separated by " | ". Comment lines are not compared.
# Conditions of this measurement (the comment lines the harness prints):
# portable-pty 0.9.0 flags: INHERIT_CURSOR | RESIZE_QUIRK | WIN32_INPUT_MODE; ESC[?9001h requested by conhost: vt=yes keys=yes (ignored, plain VT sent)
